text: This is my body after 2 years of calorie restriction. This is my body after 8 months on the shots. This is my body after just 6 weeks of using baking soda every morning. Here's exactly what happened. I was 43, and I'd been carrying the same stubborn weight for well over a decade. I thought I was doing everything right. I was consistent. I was spending the money. I was following the instructions exactly. Why was my body still not responding? Then a doctor a friend referred me to told me something that stopped me cold. The weight didn't come from eating too much. It didn't come from not moving enough. It's locked. Your cells go into a lockdown state when your internal environment becomes too acidic. And once they lock, nothing you do on the outside can reach the level where the actual release signal lives. Everything I'd been trying— the diets, the shots, the programs— were only ever hitting the surface. What I needed was something that could shift the inside environment. That's where baking soda comes in. The right combo with 2 other kitchen ingredients creates an alkaline reset that reaches the cells directly. Once the environment shifts, the cells come out of lockdown and the body starts responding in all the right places. That means chipping away at the belly, neck, and arms after years of struggle. One glass of this every morning took me about 30 seconds. Here's why it's the best thing I've tried. 6 weeks in, my clothes were fitting differently. By month 3, people were asking what I'd changed. Over 90,000 people have already used this after everything else failed them. The exact routine with the real directions are on the video at the next page.
